atDirectives.name: @master
atDirectives.description: Marks a stylesheet as a Master CSS entry.

atDirectives.name: @settings
atDirectives.description: Defines root Master CSS engine settings.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Configures source files scanned by Master CSS.

atDirectives.name: @safelist
atDirectives.description: Adds class candidates for Master CSS generation.

atDirectives.name: @blocklist
atDirectives.description: Removes class candidates from Master CSS generation.

atDirectives.name: @preserve
atDirectives.description: Preserves selected native CSS output behavior.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Loads another Master CSS stylesheet as compile-time context.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines Master CSS tokens, modes, and managed keyframes.

atDirectives.name: @defaults
atDirectives.description: Defines managed classes in the Master CSS defaults layer.

atDirectives.name: @components
atDirectives.description: Defines managed classes in the Master CSS components layer.

atDirectives.name: @utilities
atDirectives.description: Defines managed classes in the Master CSS utilities layer.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Defines reusable Master CSS condition or selector variants.

atDirectives.name: @compose
atDirectives.description: Composes Master CSS classes into native declarations.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies Master CSS variant conditions to nested styles.

atDirectives.name: @slot
atDirectives.description: Marks the insertion point inside a Master CSS custom variant.

atDirectives.name: @dark
atDirectives.description: Applies the Master CSS dark mode variant shorthand.
